## W-DAILY-BRIEF v2 additions (mobile draft, 2026-09-02, UNVERIFIED on the machine)

Three new sources for the 07:00 brief. Import this file as a scratch workflow, run **Test Run**, read the preview in Telegram, then splice the four nodes between **Set Window** and **Build v2 Sections** into the live `W-DAILY-BRIEF — 07:00 Morning Brief` (Cu6opCPfQPHJMKRJ) and append `{{ $json.v2Html }}` to its existing message expression. Do not import a second copy of the brief.

**Every source is non-fatal**: onError = continueRegularOutput on the three fetches, and `Build v2 Sections` turns a failed or empty source into one labelled line.

**1 · TickTick** — needs a new n8n credential (none exists yet):
1. developer.ticktick.com → Manage Apps → New App "n8n Hermes"; OAuth redirect URL = https://n8n.rocloyd.com/rest/oauth2-credential/callback
2. n8n → Credentials → **OAuth2 API** (generic): Grant type Authorization Code · Auth URL https://ticktick.com/oauth/authorize · Access Token URL https://ticktick.com/oauth/token · Client ID/Secret from step 1 · Scope `tasks:read tasks:write` · Authentication = Header. Name it "TickTick OAuth2 - rocloyd87". Connect + approve.
3. Select that credential on **TickTick Inbox Data** (Generic Credential Type → OAuth2 API).
4. TickTick issues long-lived tokens (~6 months) and no refresh token — when the node starts returning 401, reconnect the credential. Add a WF-CERTS-style reminder.
The Open API has no tag filter; the node fetches the Inbox project (all four #ecosystem tasks live there as of 2026-09-02) and the Code node filters status=0 AND (tag ecosystem OR due ≤ today). Inbox project id `inbox132802495` came from the TickTick connector; confirm it against GET /open/v1/project if the call 404s.

**2 · MoneyMatter subscriptions** — the connector call `get_upcoming_subscription_payments` (and `get_subscriptions`, candidates) returned **[] on 2026-09-02: zero subscriptions are defined in MoneyMatter**. The section therefore hides itself until subscriptions exist (SHOW_EMPTY_SUBS=false). To populate: run `detect_subscription_candidates` (needs finance:write — Lloyd's OK) and accept the real ones. The REST path `/api/subscriptions/upcoming` and the OAuth client are UNVERIFIED — copy the auth + base URL from the HTTP nodes in W-DASH-SYNC (T8VMaXjqt3Cyh8F3) and read the response keys once; the Code node already tolerates name/expectedAmount/nextPaymentDate variants.

**3 · Yesterday's spend** — calls the existing tool bridge `Subworkflow: Call HermesApi Tool` (AVsltr2l2KOIbSkT) with tool `spend_series`, daily granularity, 30 days ending yesterday, so the brief can say "₱X · above/below your 30-day average". The bridge's input field names and spend_series args are UNVERIFIED — copy them from the `spend_series` tool node in W-HERMES. get_kpis already covers "recurring due ≤7 d"; this section is about yesterday only.

Chat id: paste the owner id from the live brief's Config node into **Send v2 Preview** before testing. Error workflow: W-ERR (h01qmxLYAmMcwjWC).
